verdict.rationale: OpenCode is fundamentally an AI coding agent built into terminal, desktop, and IDE surfaces, letting users delegate coding tasks directly to it via CLI commands like `opencode run` or interactive sessions, with agent/subagent selection and multi-session support. Community evidence corroborates real hands-on delegation use (e.g., replacing Aider, using local/remote models as daily driver). Missing for 10: no independent benchmark of task delegation quality/reliability beyond anecdotal community reports.
